scope: N5 followup only, no inference/device/test work; large JSONL read only after run.json shutdown.passed=true and no remaining owned PID

enhancement_validation.scope: real NN/skip/field evidence, not human-labelled accuracy

shutdown.cache_scan_scope: owned service audio cache only, after process/port cleanup; read-only, no deletion
shutdown.exit_timing_scope: parent process poll observation, not device/kernel time; None when no TERM was sent

resource_recovery.scope: physical NPU7 actual MB evidence plus owned exit; nonzero aggregate delta requires shared-load review, no replacement free threshold
resource_recovery.reason: recovery not verified: inspect NPU7 numeric evidence, external changes and owned cleanup; unknown is not zero

shared_before.listening_scope: target /proc/PID/net tcp tables filtered by owned fd socket inodes

shared_after.listening_scope: target /proc/PID/net tcp tables filtered by owned fd socket inodes

limits: N5 cannot replace N6 resident acceptance and is not long-term stability proof.
HBM raw MB snapshots contain TTL repeats; resource timestamps deduplicated, gaps not interpolated.
Allocator current values may reflect last worker status/RPC, not a synchronized global atomic snapshot.
Different owner maxima are not summed; reserved-allocated is not all immediately releasable.
Pool wait/inference are accumulated host envelopes, not additive end-to-end latency or kernel time.
Host/swap system counters include external shared load and do not uniquely attribute pressure to this service.
